title: Canvas receipt effect-prefix completeness
question: Does VALID_BUT_INCOMPLETE mean a receipt remains valid for an earlier effect-stack prefix but cannot directly satisfy a later requested prefix, and does that relation remain stable across a controlled effect-state mutation?
source_note: Instrumented Adobe Artie Artisan built from SDK 25.6. Receipt checks use CanvasSuite8 while the stock renderer remains on CanvasSuite5. The same A/B render passes are correlated with EXP-RG-001 host tracing.

environment.ae_version: user-run target: installed AE 26.3; probe compiled against SDK 25.6
environment.gpu: not a manipulated factor in the prefix matrix
environment.notes: Run only in a disposable blank AE session. Canonical probe SHA-256: E3546DB78AA3454FEE5EF6C5A14A3B1152111D2A543E249C3DBB1036AE3DFF33.

hypotheses.prediction: Within each pass, generated prefix k<n returns VALID_BUT_INCOMPLETE while k>=n can return VALID.
hypotheses.falsified_by: Receipt status does not track the requested effect-prefix relation under controlled same-context state.

hypotheses.prediction: Changing Blur 10->75 does not change the abstract prefix sufficiency rule even though underlying render identity/evaluation state changes.
hypotheses.falsified_by: The prefix matrix changes meaning between A and B without a topology/effect-count change.

hypotheses.prediction: The third status instead tracks geometry/spatial completeness.
hypotheses.falsified_by: Prefix relation alone predicts the third status with both geometry-check settings.

factors: generated prefix k in 0..N plus ALL_EFFECTS
requested prefix n in 0..N plus ALL_EFFECTS
pass A blur=10 / pass B blur=75
Gaussian Blur -> Fill -> Tint topology held constant
procedure: User installs the canonical probe while AE is closed and launches a disposable blank session.
Pass A renders a 64x64 solid with Gaussian Blur=10, Fill and Tint using AEIG Receipt Probe.
The script changes only Gaussian Blur to 75 and renders pass B with identical topology.
For each pass the Artisan enumerates software-effect count, generates every prefix plus ALL_EFFECTS, and checks every requested prefix with geometry checking off/on.
analyze_receipt_experiment.py validates the prefix model independently for A and B; raw captures remain immutable evidence.
